summary.text: Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system of ancient Egypt, combining ideographic, logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements across more than 1,000 distinct characters.
They are the ultimate ancestor of the Phoenician alphabet, so most of the world's living writing systems descend from them.
Jean-François Champollion deciphered them in the 1820s with the help of the Rosetta Stone, after the nature of the script stayed unknown through the Middle Ages.

facts.label: First full sentence
facts.value: Second Dynasty, found in Seth-Peribsen's tomb

items.prompt: The Rosetta Stone carries three parallel scripts. Which set is it?

options.label: Hieroglyphs, demotic and the Greek alphabet
Hieroglyphs, cuneiform and the Aramaic script
Hieratic, Phoenician and the Latin alphabet
Demotic, Cyrillic and the Arabic alphabet

items.explain: The Rosetta Stone contains hieroglyphs, demotic and the Greek alphabet.

items.prompt: A student reads Latin letters on this page. By which route do they trace back to Egyptian hieroglyphs?

options.label: Through Mayan script and then Chinese

items.explain: Hieroglyphs are the ancestor of the Phoenician alphabet, and the Latin and Cyrillic scripts descend through Greek; Arabic and Brahmic scripts descend through Aramaic.

items.prompt: Which type of hieroglyph narrows down the meaning of a word written with other glyphs?
items.explain: Determinatives narrow down the meaning of logographic or phonetic words.

items.prompt: Hieroglyphs are thought to be one of four writing systems that arose without outside influence. Which of these is another?
items.explain: The others are cuneiform, Chinese characters and Mayan script.

items.prompt: What led to the loss of fluent readers and writers of hieroglyphs in the 5th century?

options.label: The closing of pagan temples in Roman Egypt
The arrival of Arab armies in the country
A shift to writing only on papyrus sheets
The Persian conquest of the whole country

items.explain: The permanent closing of pagan temples across Roman Egypt resulted in the loss of fluent scribes.

items.prompt: As writing spread among ordinary Egyptians, simpler forms grew out of hieroglyphs inside Egypt. Which pair were they?
items.explain: Simplified glyph forms developed into the hieratic (priestly) and demotic (popular) scripts, which suited papyrus better.
